messages.subject: tabsetPanel in a tabsetPanel ?
parts:
Hi all
I would like to create two levels of tabsetPanel but it seems that a tabsetPanel cannot contain himself a tabsetPanel.
My code would look like :

tabsetPanel(id= "tabs",
                  tabsetPanel(id="tab1", 
                                    tabPanel("tab1_1"),
                                    tabPanel("tab1_2")
                                    ),
                  tabsetPanel(id="tab2",
                                    tabPanel("tab2_1"),
                                    tabPanel("tab2_2")
                                    )
                 )

It is something possible with Shiny ?

Thanks for help

Sam

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: tabsetPanel in a tabsetPanel ?
parts:
two levels of tabsetPanel sound a bit ambiguous. I can think of two meaning

1) You want to have two rows of tabs on top. But there is not only one tabPanel; I am guessing that's not what you mean

2) Within tabset panel you want to have another set of panels? I think this is what you mean

Try this: 

    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel(title="hello","hello",
        tabsetPanel(
          tabPanel(title="hi"),
          tabPanel(title="hi2")
        )
      ),
      tabPanel(title="wassup","wassup2",
               tabsetPanel(
                 tabPanel(title="hi3"),
                 tabPanel(title="hi4")
               )
      )        
    )
